name: analyzing-video
title_zh: 抽帧转写双轨并行，视频里发生的事它全看见
tagline_zh: 屏幕录制或随手拍的视频，运动轨迹和说话内容都要看——它抽帧看画面、转写听声音，不靠一张静态截图猜剧情。
tagline_en: For screen recordings or any clip where motion and speech matter—it samples frames for visuals and transcribes.
desc_en: How to understand what happens in a video file over time -- your own screen recording or any video the user points you at -- by sampling frames and transcribing the audio track, instead of a single static screenshot. Use this whenever a video's motion/dynamics or spoken content matters, not just one still moment.
why_zh: 双通道采样：画面抽帧捕捉动态，音轨转写捕捉台词，比单张截图多一个时间维度的信息，适合教程、会议。
why_en: Dual-channel: sampled frames catch motion, transcribed audio catches speech—adds a time dimension a single screenshot lacks.
limit_zh: 只处理视频文件本身，不接直播流；抽帧间隔和转写语言需按内容手动调；产物是文字+帧描述，不生成剪辑或摘要视频。
limit_en: Works on video files only, not live streams. Frame rate and transcription language need manual tuning per content. Output is text + frame notes, not.
title_en: Frame sampling + audio transcription to read any video
